summary.text: Mitch Clemmons, a Republican plumbing contractor and small-business owner, lost the November 3, 2026 election for the U.S. House seat in California's 41st District to Linda Sánchez.
He has operated his own plumbing company since 2002, ran unsuccessfully for state Senate in 2022 and has not held elected office.

paragraphs.text: Clemmons earned a high school diploma from Santa Fe High School and studied aerospace engineering technology at California State Polytechnic University, Pomona, according to Ballotpedia.
He worked as a warehouse manager for Lantis Eyewear before starting a plumbing company that he has operated since 2002.

In his Ballotpedia Candidate Connection survey, he describes himself as a family man, local plumbing contractor and small business owner who has helped employees earn plumbing licenses and start their own businesses.
Clemmons ran for California State Senate District 30 in 2022 as a Republican. He advanced from the primary but lost the general election to incumbent Democrat Bob Archuleta, 61% to 39%.
He received 32.5% of the vote to Linda Sánchez's 67.5%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
